text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several weeks had passed since we secluded 
ourselves in the mountains alongside 
summer training camp...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart is not here right now. She 
has taken Daring Tact deeper into the 
mountains on a survival excursion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To run in the Queen Stakes, we have to 
head to the airport tomorrow. The 
appointed time was drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hmm... This is unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's completely washed out by a landslide. 
I wonder if it's from the rain the day 
before yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If we took this mountain path, we'd be 
back in no time! I can't believe we have 
to take a detour.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...However, that will take too much time. 
We won't make it to our meetup."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you're late for our meetup by even a 
single second--

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Canceling the run in the Queen Stakes! 
That was our promise, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, getting injured because you rushed 
would defeat the whole purpose. We know 
the detour, so let's take the safe route.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...That's an option too, but if we climb 
the cliff behind us, it looks like there's 
a spot we can leap across from.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But on that cliff... there are barely 
any handholds, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the lead and clear the way! 
That'll definitely get us there faster.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, it will be a harsh ascent, 
so first you will need to trust me—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Okay! Let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind strictness at all. Believing 
in you is second nature to me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I have no reason to refuse such a 
proposal. Let's get right to it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Heart-san, the next ledge... It's pretty 
hard to grip, so please be careful...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, you're right, my fingers are about 
to cramp...! But—I won't lose... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems a lot happened along the way, 
but... we managed to safely meet up with 
Daring Heart and the others and finish our 
preparations for the trip.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Um, here... If you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This is a stone I found previously. 
...Please take a look at its shape.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It's so cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Right? So... think of it as a good luck 
charm.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
We're watching the race from the training 
camp lodge! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thank you! —I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: Is that a stone you got from Takt?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...I really got energized by that."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She was helping me the whole time in the 
mountains, so it's about time I show her 
my cool side!
choice_data_list: If I win today, I can prove it. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sapporo Racecourse uses European turf, 
which is rare in Japan. I have to adapt to 
the difference from standard wild grass 
and harness my power effectively."
choice_data_list:
It's a tough course if you're not used to 
it.

It's a tough course if you aren't used to 
it, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know it's a unique track condition. 
*But*, with this brave heart of mine! 
Let's dive right in without a rehearsal♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Not that you'd ever let that happen, 
right? I know you."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I have the course characteristics 
memorized.

Yeah, I've got the course characteristics 
memorized.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Wow, how reliable! So, what should I do?"
choice_data_list: Let's just eliminate any wasted movement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sapporo Racecourse is a tight-turning, 
flat track. I'll take a good position 
early on, and advance using my 
'fatigue-free technique'—"
choice_data_list:
It's a review of your junior year—you can 
handle it, right?

It's a review of your junior year—you've 
got this, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Piece of cake! Plus... we'll do a recap 
to reaffirm our presence once more, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There were so many different talents 
gathered on the Triple Tiara route, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I am the Queen who truly suits the tiara! 
I'll go make that crystal clear!
